token_set.name: Hometown History: Chicago Blackhawks
token_set.description: Introducing Hometown History: Chicago Blackhawks, a compilation of highlights commemorating historical moments celebrated by the Blackhawks during the 2023-24 season.  These collectibles not only honor the rich history of the team but also rewind the clock to capture the players and achievements that solidify the franchise in the hearts of fans, and within the pages of NHL history.

description:
1995 Western Conference Semifinals OT Winner #1: On May 25, 1995, Chelios closed out Game 3 of the Western Conference Semifinals versus the Vancouver Canucks at Pacific Coliseum. In the first overtime, Bernie Nicholls found Chelios entering the offensive zone where No. 7 faked a slap shot, freezing goaltender Kirk McLean and sliding in a goal that propelled the Hawks to a 3-0 series lead. Chicago would go on to sweep the series and advance to the Western Conference Final versus the rival Detroit Red Wings.
